text:
Situation: Metronidazole 500 mg/100 mL solution is in shortage at Corvale East (9.6 days on hand) while Corvale General holds 21.7 days. Corvale Lakeside has 21 days. The shortage has been ongoing since 2022.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the metronidazole shortage on 2022-01-13 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. Gland Pharma Limited and InfoRLife SA (labeler Hospira Inc.) are also listed as current shortages. A Warning Letter was issued to a Baxter plant on 2026-09-29. A second Baxter plant at FEI 2618677 has a history of OAI classifications in 2010, 2013, 2014, 2015, and 2016, with the most recent inspection VAI on 2024-07-19.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new procurement risk. External purchases are available from suppliers not on FDA's shortage list today, but plant visibility varies.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 64 units of 500 mg/100 mL, 100 mL bags from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Hospira, Inc. (Infomed Fluids Srl, last inspection VAI 2023-04-07) — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited — requires buyer approval; label names no identifiable plant.
4. Evaluate purchase from Civica, Inc. — requires buyer approval; label names no identifiable plant.
5. Evaluate purchase from WG Critical Care, LLC — requires buyer approval; label names no identifiable plant.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting new vendor qualification; relying solely on Corvale Lakeside stock; assuming FDA's shortage posting will resolve without action.
